name: Silent and Unseen
body:
School transmutation; Level druid 2, ranger 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 minute
Saving Throw none; see text; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You gain a +10 bonus to Stealth for 1 minute. In addition, for the spell’s duration any enemy targeting you with a melee, ranged, or ranged touch attack must make a Will save or believe you vanish right before their eyes (you do not actually vanish, your opponent just thinks that you do).
